caption:
A cluttered cabinet doesn't need a full overhaul—just something under your dishes and cans that stops them from sliding every time the door opens.

Wire racks and bare wood let jars tip and glasses shift, so you end up straightening shelves or digging around just to find what you need.

A non-adhesive, non-slip shelf liner like this one fixes that without any mess—no glue, no residue, just lay it down. It holds a 4.7-star rating across 2,556 reviews.

At $7.99 for a 12" x 10FT roll, it's a cheap way to keep shelves in order, one cabinet at a time.
